findings.body: [General] The scope rename is not fully reflected in the scope-based documentation filter: `instrumentation-docs/.../TelemetryParser.java:74` still accepts `io.opentelemetry.mongo-3.7` for this module, and `TelemetryParserTest` still requires that legacy value to be valid. This leaves the compatibility path in place and can classify stale legacy-scope telemetry as current; remove the allow-list entry and update its test.

[General] The scope-based documentation filter still treats `io.opentelemetry.ratpack-1.7` as valid telemetry for the `ratpack-1.4` agent module (`instrumentation-docs/.../TelemetryParser.java:73`), and its test locks in that legacy alias. Since this change makes the agent emit `ratpack-1.4` unconditionally, remove that allow-list entry and update the parser test so stale legacy-scope data is no longer accepted.

[Javaagent] `JaxrsCodeAttributesGetter` is a stateless attributes getter, so retaining it as a singleton field conflicts with the repository convention and unnecessarily extends its lifetime. Keep it local to instrumenter registration, as the previous static initializer did.

metadata.body:
Finalize the six emitted scope renames for JAX-RS, CXF/Metro JAX-WS, MongoDB, Ratpack HTTP client, and Tomcat JDBC. Update scope-based views and filters, for example:

```diff
- otel.scope.name="io.opentelemetry.tomcat-jdbc"
+ otel.scope.name="io.opentelemetry.tomcat-jdbc-8.5"
```

The changelog lists all six migrations.

Remove the deprecated meter-based factories from the alpha `DbConnectionPoolMetrics` API. Use the `OpenTelemetry` factory instead:

```java
DbConnectionPoolMetrics.create(openTelemetry, "my.instrumentation", "my-pool", attributes);
```

Part of #20510.
